assumptions: This reading models the announced exemption's applicability, conditional on classification under the referenced margin regime; it does not determine the circular's independent legal force.
The stated commencement date is inclusive. Amendment and gazettal are treated as pending implementation steps because the supplied text does not expressly condition commencement on them.
Overseas monitoring, reporting and duration provisions are explanatory background rather than incorporated SFC requirements.
The absence of a supplied later notice does not establish that no relevant later notice exists.

citations.quote: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) issues this circular to inform licensed corporations that it will exempt non-centrally cleared single-stock options, equity basket options and equity index options (collectively, “non-centrally cleared equity options”) from its margin requirements1 from 4 January 2026 until further notice to align with the latest global developments.
considering that licensed corporations’ exposures to non-centrally cleared equity options are currently insignificant

In the EU, a permanent exemption from the requirement to exchange margin for single-stock equity options and equity index options became effective on 24 December 2024, subject to monitoring and periodic reporting2.
It implemented an indefinite exemption from the UK bilateral margining requirements for single-stock equity options and index options.
Paragraph 7(e) of Part III of Schedule 10 to the Code of Conduct will be amended accordingly and gazetted in due course.
1 As set out in Part III of Schedule 10 to the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Code of Conduct).

mutant.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Selected control: applicability of the announced SFC equity-options margin exemption. Within the declared actor and underlying margin-regime scope, true means the selected transaction is a listed non-centrally cleared equity option, the assessment date is on or after 2026-01-04, and no effective further notice has displaced reliance on this announcement for it. False means at least one of those conditions fails; it does not establish a margin breach or exclude another exemption. Outside scope this control makes no determination. Unknown inputs remain unknown.
